term.label: RNA_7SK

definition.text: An abundant small nuclear RNA that, together with associated cellular proteins, regulates the activity of the positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb). It is often described in literature as similar to a snRNA, except of longer length.

comments: Added as a request from FlyBase. See GitHub Issue #512
